whole_source_absence_method: Inspected all six full sources, not retrieved snippets. Each absent value checked against the full related family; other family inspected as unrelated. Context quotes alone do not prove corpus-wide absence.
alternative_method: Per-fact independent sufficient passages found in the whole corpus are combined by Cartesian product. All minimal chunk covers, including overlap duplicates, enumerated. Corroborating fragments that cannot establish the whole fact are documented separately. Semantic completeness awaits independent review.
not_tuned_to_context: No context count/length or tokenizer fit used to shorten source, filter evidence or select questions. Alternatives remain regardless of eventual retrieval.
